I No. S. 99-

THE CONSTITUTION OF THE STATE OF

BRUNEI, 1959 THE CONSTITUTION (TRANSFER OF FUNCTIONS AND CONSEQUENTIAL PROVISIONS) ORDER, 1959 .(Made under section 80) In exercise of the powers conferred on him by section 80 of the Constitution of the State of Brunei, 1959, the Sultan has made the following OrderCitation and 1. This Order may be cited as the Constitucommencement. tion (Transfer of Functions and Consequential Provisions) Order, 1959, and shall come into force on the same date as Part III of the Constitution. Interpretation. 2. In this Order"Constitution" means the Constitution of the State of Brunei, 1959; "functions" includes any powers, duties, privileges or benefits conferred or imposed by any written law on any person or authority; "the Resident" means the British Resident for the State. Transfer of 3. ( l) Subject to paragraphs (2) and (3), the functions. functions conferred or imposed on the person or authority specified in the first column of the First Schedule by the provision of law specified opposite thereto in the second column of that Schedule are hereby transferred to the person or authority specified opposite thereto in the third column of that Schedule.

(2) The Mentri Besar may, with the approval of the Sultan, delegate to the State Secretary, the Attorney-General or the State Financial Officer any of the functions vested in the Mentri Besar by virtue of paragraph ( 1 ).

(3) References to the Clerk to the Executive Council shall, until the commencement of Part V of the Constitution, be construed as references to the Clerk to the State Council. Amendment of 4. The written laws specified in the first certain written column of the Second Schedule are amended in the Jaws. manner specified in the second and third columns of that Schedule.
